## What's free

Managed Nebula mesh: up to 100 hosts, managed lighthouse, SSO and 2 routes; then $1/host/month

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://www.defined.net/pricing/> before relying on this.

## Notes

Nebula itself is open source, so you can export host configs and run your own CA. The Terraform provider is third-party; check that API keys are available on the free plan.

## Plan

- `stack/`: a root module that reads the hybrid inventory (`hybrid/` state) and wires every host (DNS records, mesh ACLs, tunnels)
